name: app-design-research
description: Review iPhone app screens, interface text, and code with evidence-backed iOS design guidance.

interface.longDescription: Review iPhone app screenshots, interface text, or code. Get up to three prioritized improvements with evidence and ways to validate them. Guidance covers SwiftUI and UIKit, accessible interfaces, widgets, and Live Activities. Hugging App proposes changes; your agent implements them only when you ask. It does not fetch websites or publish apps. Your agent host processes supplied material and controls retention.
defaultPrompt: Review this iPhone app screen or code. Give up to three evidence-backed improvements and a way to validate each.
